Definition: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be like, resemble; 1a) (Qal) to be like, resemble; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to liken, compare; 1b2) to imagine, think; 1c) (Hithpael) to make oneself like; 1d) (Niphal)
